kitDescription: K is an Electric SMG Attacker who builds a crit-rate stacking buff called Tilted Scale every time she empties a magazine (+29 stacks of 0.75% crit per last bullet, capped at 100 stacks = +75% crit), and the stacks are wiped each time Full Burst ends, creating a build-dump sawtooth. While she holds Tilted Scale, her whole team carries a paired buff/debuff: +10.62% attack damage but -51.13% max ammo for 10s, which also shortens her own magazine and speeds her stacking loop. Every 4 critical pellet hits she procs a 23.9%-of-ATK hit on the boss. Her burst swaps her SMG for a slow 10-pellet weapon at 92.5% per pellet for 10s, plus large self ATK and attack-damage buffs for the window, so the burst window is her dominant damage phase.

S1b 'rider exists exactly once at 23.9%' (driver UNMODELED the rider)
S1b 'is a hit-counted rider' (no rider block to inspect)

Burst 'swap at 92.5% of final ATK' (driver uses 925 via the 10-pellet EV-collapse — contradicted by the S6 blind, which also chose 925; spurious)

The driver and S6 chose opposite approximations: driver = exact window magnitude, no pre-burst ramp (under-credit, conservative); S6 = exact cap and trigger, no wipe (over-credit post-FB). Note-level arithmetic slip: the ~33s-to-cap claim ignores the S2 ammo cut accelerating the loop (~5s magazines once live) — harmless, in the note only.

gotchas.summary: Tilted Scale's literal stack-ramp sawtooth (+29 stacks/last-bullet, cap 100, wiped at FB end) is un-encodable — no '+N stacks per application' primitive and no FB-end buff-removal primitive. Driver encodes only the steady-state burst-window observable (critRatePct 75/10s on burstCast), under-crediting the pre-burst SMG crit ramp and the first-burst build.
gotchas.evidence: Kit: 'Tilted Scale: Critical Rate 0.75% continuously, stacks up to 100 times / stacks 29 / Removes Tilted Scale' vs engine facts (b)+(c); driver caveat 4 (estimate + recipe + MEASUREMENT-GATED tier); S6 independently hit the same wall and chose the opposite approximation (exact cap/trigger, no wipe).
gotchas.suggestedFix: Engine work, not a fudge: add a stacksPerApply field on buff effects and a removeBuff effect keyed to fullBurstEnd, then re-author as lastBullet critRatePct 0.75 stacksPerApply 29 maxStacks 100 + FB-end removal. Until then, the driver's caveat recipe (burst-window crit-popup read at ~90%) is the measurement gate.

gotchas.summary: The 23.9% rider is crit-COUNT-gated and no crit-gated hit counter exists; driver dropped it (documented ⚑, ~5% of burst damage) rather than fire a round-counted hitCount that would over-proc 3-10x early and miss the ramp.
gotchas.evidence: Kit: 'when pellets land a critical hit 4 time(s) / Deals 23.9% of final ATK' vs engine fact (d); S2b flagged the same missing primitive; S6's hitCount:5 is a static ⚑ for a cadence that accelerates with Tilted Scale.
gotchas.suggestedFix: Add a requiresCrit/countCrits variant of hitCount (engine work). Interim measurement recipe (driver's): count 23.9% rider popups per burst window in focus footage to set a crit-rate-weighted threshold — but only after the crit counter exists, since the cadence is non-stationary.

gotchas.summary: The 10 pellets are merged into a single 925% hit per pull. EV-exact for damage under deterministic crit, but the collapse erases per-pellet core/landing geometry and the per-pellet crit count that feeds the (already unmodeled) rider; the swap keeps base SMG range/core profile with the changed weapon's class kit-silent.
gotchas.evidence: Kit: 'Pelletcount: 10 / Attack speed: 90%' vs engine fact (a) (effectivePellets is SG-only AND swap-off) and fact (f) (EV-identical collapse); driver caveats 1-3 ⚑; S6 independently chose the same merge.
gotchas.suggestedFix: Needs measurement, not a number: frame-read one burst window for popup count/values per pull (10 small vs 1 large) to confirm the split; if real pellets land fractionally, revisit swap pellet support in the engine rather than adjusting damagePct.

verdictRationale: Every divergence the S5 blind run exposed is either (a) a documented engine-primitive gap both blind agents independently hit (no stacks-per-apply, no FB-end removal, no crit-gated counter — the Tilted Scale sawtooth and the crit-count rider are genuinely un-encodable today, and the driver's workarounds are flagged with estimate + recipe + tier rather than fudged), or (b) spurious: the S5 92.5-per-pellet assertion is refuted by the S6 blind's identical 925 choice plus engine facts (a) and (f), and the durationShots-null failure is a test artifact whose timed-window intent passes. The encodable 6 of 9 lines (all of skill2's live effects and the entire burst) show exact three-way convergence — driver, S6 blind override, and S2b spec agree on trigger, scope, stat, magnitude, and duration — and the driver's tests genuinely discriminate (no-swap zeroes the window, 92.5 cuts it ~10x, weakTilted reads 0.3675 vs 0.90). Residual same-model risk the owner should spot-check: (1) the pellet split-vs-merge read is kit-silent and both agents shared the same 'merge or the burst is a downgrade' prior — one burst-window popup read settles it; (2) the driver's burst-window-only Tilted Scale encoding is the conservative of the two blind approximations, but its '~33s to cap' note arithmetic ignores the ammo-cut acceleration. Neither blocks: the gotchas are documented, bounded (med/med/low), and the fix path is named engine work, not re-tuned numbers.
